title: Antiracist Curriculum and Digital Platforms: Evidence from Black Lives Matter
eligible_reason: No data shipped: the DonorsChoose panel is proprietary under a research agreement (readme.xlsx); the package contains only the R Markdown, its HTML output and a scraper. Design: the headline Table 1 and Figures 4, 6, 7 compare anti-racism vs other project requests within school-week around a single event date (George Floyd, rel_weeks >= 0), i.e. single-date DiD; Table 1 columns 2-3 pool 13 other racial-justice events in event time (stacked across events), which is excluded. Figure 8 re-times treatment to the week of the first protest in each school's city (rel_protest_week), which varies across cities and is the only staggered component; for the Floyd event this is a plausibly qualifying staggered event study (unit = school x project type, treated rows = anti-racism requests, never-treated = other requests), but it uses school FE plus a racism indicator rather than school-by-project-type FE and is a mechanism figure. It cannot be replicated without data.
design_notes: Panel 'Full panel complete.csv' (not shipped): school_id x project type (variable = racism/control) x week_clean, with event_name, event_date, rel_weeks, first_protest_week, heterogeneity flags (black_high, democrat, gt_high). Table 1: felm(n ~ racism + racism:after | week_clean + school_id | 0 | school_state) with after = rel_weeks >= 0; col1 Floyd only (rel_weeks<=8), col2 other events pooled, col3 all events pooled, col4 extended window, cols 5-7 triple interactions with heterogeneity flags. Figure 4/6/7: event-study racism:relevel(rel_weeks, ref=-1) for Floyd (single date) and other events (pooled). Figure 8: racism:relevel(rel_protest_week, ref=-1), |rel_protest_week|<=8, Floyd and pooled other events separately.
estimators_reported: event-stacked DiD across events (Table 1 cols 2-3, Figure 4 other events)
event study around city first-protest week (Figure 8)

screener_notes: Screened from package only (readme.xlsx, Rmd read for Table 1, Figures 4, 6-8). No article text available; table/figure numbers come from Rmd section headers.
hand_check_nov4: Not a near-miss: single adoption date. The headline DiD compares anti-racism and other project requests around the George Floyd week (Table 1 col 1, Figures 4, 6, 7); Table 1 cols 2-3 pool other events in event time; the only staggered component (Figure 8, city first-protest week) is a mechanism figure with school FE plus a project-type indicator rather than unit FE (article text: Figure 8 'point toward a causal effect of local protests'). near_miss stays false; eligible_design true is a legacy coding (no qualifying column).
